outOfScope: selection order of the seven chosen papers
unfinished digest integration outside these four report bodies
running or reproducing model and robot experiments

method: Read each production report independently against the fixed primary PDF or HTML, including tables, equations, negative results, and limitations.
Reopened the cited related works from their own primary pages or fixed local captures instead of relying on the reviewed paper's related-work summary.
Inspected resource claims against the fixed paper pages and, for LiDAR-Hallu, the official repository README and directory listing.
Opened all eight production PNGs with view_image; STAR transparent originals were additionally inspected through the supplied white-background QA copies.
Recomputed SHA-256 for all four production reports and all eight production PNGs after the parent source-delimiter and DRT&R tag fixes.

Executed buildPaperSourceLinks on the final frontmatter: MM-Future and STAR each resolve to one clean arXiv link, LiDAR-Hallu to clean arXiv and code links, and DRT&R to one clean arXiv link. All HTTPS URLs extracted from the four final Markdown files parse successfully without concatenated punctuation or adjacent labels.
